scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent || !process.env.npm_config_user_agent.startsWith('pnpm')) { process.stderr.write('Use pnpm instead\n'); process.exit(1); }" || true
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
